svg.title: Multi-tab token refresh flow
svg.desc: Activity timing and logout are synchronized across tabs for the project's 15-minute inactivity policy. The diagram below focuses on token refresh: Web Locks coordinate refresh work and BroadcastChannel distributes the refreshed Access Token. IdleTimer uses its own channel for activity synchronization. A separate authentication channel carries logout and refreshed tokens; tabs that are logging out do not adopt incoming tokens.

div.style: color: rgb(23, 37, 84) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: Several tabs need a fresh token
